candidates.title: Kondo constant-wavelength prior vs Ca²⁺ inter-event regularity (ISI CV gate)

candidates.done: `morphoeval/scout_runs/scout-036-kondo-isi-cv.json` parses and reports `cv_isi` from `analyze_oscillatory_coherence()` on post-poke rows for embryos A and B separately, plus `kondo_spacing_cv_reference` copied from `datasets/turing/turing_reference.json` (max–min spacing / mean over stages).
